excerpt_i18n.en: On Tuesday, OpenAI announced it will introduce an age recognition model for its personal version of ChatGPT, helping the AI company identify accounts of users under 18. The company stated that this model operates by analyzing a combination of account data signals and user behavior data signals. Specific signals include users' long-term usage habits, account registration duration, daily active time periods, and self-reported age information.
excerpt_i18n.es: OpenAI anunció el martes que lanzará un modelo de verificación de edad para su versión personal de ChatGPT, con el objetivo de ayudar a esta empresa de inteligencia artificial a identificar las cuentas de usuarios menores de 18 años. La compañía señaló que el funcionamiento de este modelo se basa en el análisis combinado de señales de datos de la cuenta y de comportamiento del usuario. Las señales específicas incluyen los hábitos de uso a largo plazo, el tiempo de registro de la cuenta, los períodos de actividad diaria y la información de edad proporcionada por el usuario. items.title: A curated list of academic papers and resources on Physical AI
items.raw_excerpt: I've been compiling papers on Physical AI — the intersection of foundation models and robotics. This covers Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models like RT-2 and π₀, world models (DreamerV3, Genie 2, JEPA), diffusion policies, real-world deployment and latency problems, cross-embodiment transfer, scaling laws, and safety/alignment for robots. The field has exploded in the past 18 months. We went from "lets try llms on robotics" to having so many dimensions to optimize for. so felt right to maintain a running list of resources. Organized by: foundations → architectures → action representations → world models → learning paradigms → deployment → applications. Contributions welcome — especially corrections and missing papers.

items.title: WhoDB CLI – Terminal database client (Golang) with local AI support
items.raw_excerpt:
We built a terminal database client that lets you connect to multiple databases and interact with them through a TUI. It’s open source (Apache 2.0). Motivation:
My cofounder and I were tired of switching between pgAdmin-style GUIs and the psql CLI. Some tasks are faster in a UI, others in a terminal. So we built a TUI inspired by k9s that tries to cover both. Features:
* Visual WHERE condition builder (column / operator / value via dropdowns)
* Natural language → SQL via AI (explicit consent required); supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama (more planned)
* Schema-aware autocomplete for tables and columns
* Grid-based table browser with keyboard navigation
* Built-in MCP server (we use it with Claude Code locally and want to add it to the official plugin list)
* Supports all core WhoDB databas

Over the past year, cloud providers like GCP and Oracle have regained market attention due to breakthroughs in AI cloud capabilities, with industry perceptions and valuations being periodically reshaped. Meanwhile, a group of vertical cloud service providers focused on specific scenarios such as AI inference and training have also stepped into the spotlight. At a recent cloud and security business review and outlook event, Li Sheng revealed, "Growth in Greater China has been a highlight of Akamai's global business. In 2025, the cloud computing business achieved an annual growth rate of nearly 40% compared to 2024." This performance stands out notably amid the overall slowdown in cloud market growth. excerpt_i18n.es: La IA está llevando a la industria de la computación en la nube a una fase de "reajuste". En el último año, proveedores de nube como GCP y Oracle han recuperado la atención del mercado debido a avances en capacidades de IA en la nube, y la percepción y valoración de estos proveedores están siendo remodeladas cíclicamente. Al mismo tiempo, un grupo de proveedores de servicios en la nube verticales, centrados en escenarios específicos como el razonamiento y entrenamiento de IA, también ha comenzado a ganar protagonismo. Como señaló Li Sheng, vicepresidente de Akamai y gerente general para la región de Gran China: en el futuro, no solo habrá competencia entre los gigantes tradicionales de la nube, sino que también veremos la aparición de proveedores de servicios en la nube altamente personalizados para aplicaciones de IA.

excerpt_i18n.en:
Recently, Dongyi Technology announced the completion of a 100-million-yuan-level Angel++ round of financing, bringing its cumulative angel round funding to over 200 million yuan. This round continues to reflect strong capital recognition of Dongyi Technology's "full-stack self-developed" technical approach and "superhuman" dynamic performance achievements. Investors in this round include Haizhu Chengfa, Guangzhou Industrial Investment, Jinyu Maowu, Xichuang Investment, Jinshajiang United, Datai Capital, and Fuzhuo Investment, with existing shareholder Puchao Capital making an additional follow-on investment.  

As a rising force in embodied intelligence founded just over a year ago, Dongyi Technology has secured multiple rounds of capital support thanks to its "full-stack self-developed" technical barriers and differentiated product strategy. This latest funding will further accelerate the iteration of general-purpose humanoid robots and core joint module technologies, advance commercialization across multiple scenarios, and expand its global footprint.  

By building core barriers through full-stack self-development, Dongyi Technology’s product matrix meets diverse scenario needs. Since its establishment in September 2024, the company has adhered to the vision of "Robot for AI," with "full-stack self-development" as its core strategy. It has built closed-loop capabilities from underlying hardware to software systems, driving the transition of artificial intelligence from "cognitive intelligence" to "embodied intelligence," and has established differentiated competitiveness in the industry.  

Pioneering a unique path of "general motion control model × embodied body":  
On the software side, the new generation of end-to-end motion control models eliminates the need to break down subtasks and can directly output robot joint control commands, significantly improving motion generalization and robustness, and addressing the traditional robot issues of "rigid movements and difficulty adapting to scenarios."  
On the hardware side, the globally innovative third-generation PhyArc series joint modules are hailed as the "hexagonal warriors among joints."
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Dongyi Technology anunció la finalización de una ronda de financiación ángel++ de cientos de millones de yuanes, acumulando una financiación total en la ronda ángel de más de 200 millones de yuanes. Esta ronda refleja el continuo reconocimiento por parte del capital hacia la ruta tecnológica de "desarrollo propio de pila completa" y los logros de rendimiento dinámico "sobrehumano" de Dongyi Technology. Los inversores de esta ronda incluyen Haizhu Chengfa, Guangzhou Chantou, Jinyu Maowu, Xichuangtou, Jinshajiang United, Datai Capital y Fuzhuo Investment, mientras que el accionista existente, Puchao Capital, realizó una inversión adicional excedente. Como nueva fuerza en inteligencia encarnada con poco más de un año desde su fundación, Dongyi Technology, gracias a su barrera tecnológica de "desarrollo propio de pila completa" y su diferenciada disposición de productos, ha recibido múltiples apoyos de capital. Esta financiación acelerará aún más la iteración tecnológica de robots humanoides universales y módulos de articulaciones centrales, así como la comercialización en múltiples escenarios.

items.raw_excerpt: 1月18日下午，2025年全国大学生计算机系统能力大赛暨第五届OceanBase数据库大赛在北京科技大学落幕。本届赛事吸引全国高校的1223支队伍、2620名学生参赛。经过两个多月比拼，北邮「编程高手」队凭借在数据库内核优化与AI应用开发中的综合表现，夺得冠军及10万元奖金。   OceanBase数据库大赛自2021年发起，2023年纳入全国大学生计算机系统能力大赛体系，为教育部认定的A类学科竞赛。本届赛事由系统能力培养研究专家组发起，全国高等学校计算机教育研究会、系统能力培养研究项目示范高校共同主办，北京科技大学、OceanBase联合承办。五年来赛事累计覆盖500余所高校、超1.1万名学生，成为我国数据库领域核心人才培养的重要平台。  当前，大模型与RAG（检索增强生成）技术加速落地，企业AI应用对数据系统提出了全新要求：既要支持语义检索与结构化过滤等混合查询，也要满足权限控制、可追溯与一致性等治理要求，实现AI“答得准、跑得快、用得稳”。业内认为，传统“搜索引擎+数据库”拼接架构在延迟、复杂度、数据一致性等方面难以满足规模化应用，原生支持混合查询与多模态检索的 AI 原生数据库将迎来新一轮爆发式需求。  围绕这一趋势，本届大赛采用“初赛+决赛”递进赛制。初赛基于实战项目MiniOB，要求选手从零实现数据库核心模块并集成向量检索功能，夯实系统底层能力。决赛首次引入Apache 2.0开源的AI原生数据库OceanBase seekdb，设置“内核优化”与“AI应用开发”两道赛题：前者要求在8核16GB单机环境下，极致提升“全文检索+标量过滤”混合查询性能，召回率不低于0.95；后者要求基于自优化后的seekdb，构建端到端的多模态RAG系统，在限定时间内输出准确答案，并可追溯至PDF页码或图表来源。两道赛题分别对应AI

excerpt_i18n.en:
On the afternoon of January 18, the 2025 National College Student Computer System Capability Competition and the 5th OceanBase Database Competition concluded at the University of Science and Technology Beijing. This year's event attracted 1,223 teams and 2,620 students from universities across the country. After over two months of competition, the "Programming Experts" team from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications won the championship and a 100,000-yuan prize, thanks to their comprehensive performance in database kernel optimization and AI application development.  

The OceanBase Database Competition was launched in 2021 and was integrated into the National College Student Computer System Capability Competition system in 2023, recognized as a Class A academic competition by the Ministry of Education. This year's competition was initiated by the System Capability Cultivation Research Expert Group and jointly organized by the National Higher Education Computer Education Research Association and the System Capability Cultivation Research Project Demonstration Universities, with the University of Science and Technology Beijing and OceanBase co-hosting. Over the past five years, the competition has covered more than 500 universities and over 11,000 students, becoming a key platform for cultivating core talent in China's database field.  

Currently, with the rapid adoption of large models and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technologies, enterprise AI applications are placing new demands on data systems: they must support hybrid queries such as semantic retrieval and structured filtering while meeting governance requirements like access control, traceability, and consistency, ensuring AI responses are accurate, fast, and stable. The industry believes that traditional "search engine + database" architectures struggle to meet the demands of large-scale applications in terms of latency, complexity, and data consistency, highlighting the need for native support for hybrid queries and multimodal retrieval.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 18 de enero por la tarde, la Competencia Nacional de Habilidades de Sistemas Informáticos para Estudiantes Universitarios 2025 y la Quinta Edición de la Competencia de Bases de Datos OceanBase concluyeron en la Universidad de Ciencia y Tecnología de Beijing. Este evento atrajo la participación de 1.223 equipos y 2.620 estudiantes de universidades de todo el país. Después de más de dos meses de competición, el equipo "Expertos en Programación" de la Universidad de Correos y Telecomunicaciones de Beijing ganó el campeonato y un premio de 100.000 yuanes, gracias a su destacado desempeño en la optimización del núcleo de bases de datos y el desarrollo de aplicaciones de IA. La Competencia de Bases de Datos OceanBase se inició en 2021 y se integró en el sistema de la Competencia Nacional de Habilidades de Sistemas Informáticos para Estudiantes Universitarios en 2023, siendo reconocida como una competencia de clase A por el Ministerio de Educación. Esta edición fue organizada por la Investigación de Desarrollo de Habilidades de Sistemas.

items.title: 欧洲科学院院士刘向阳：许多企业的数字化底座，配不上今天的AI发展 | GAIR 2025
items.raw_excerpt: 2025年12月12-13日，第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会在深圳·博林天瑞喜来登酒店正式启幕。 作为AI 产学研投界的标杆盛会，GAIR自2016年创办以来，始终坚守“传承+创新”内核，始终致力于连接技术前沿与产业实践。 在人工智能逐步成为国家竞争核心变量的当下，算力正以前所未有的速度重塑技术路径与产业结构。13日举办的“AI 算力新十年”专场聚焦智能体系的底层核心——算力，从架构演进、生态构建到产业化落地展开系统讨论，试图为未来十年的中国AI产业，厘清关键变量与发展方向。 会上，欧洲科学院院士、美的首席信息安全官兼软件工程院院长、IEEE Fellow、IET  Fellow、ACM杰出科学家刘向阳，在大会上带来题为《中立云：赋能AI与AI赋能的多云统一数字化底座》的主题演讲，分享了美的在企业级数字化与AI实践中的真实路径。   深耕数字化与信息安全领域的刘向阳，曾任职蚂蚁集团首席科学家、美国高校教授，如今在美的集团主导数字化底座与信息安全建设。他敏锐指出，当前多数企业在 AI 落地中面临 “数字化底座薄弱” 的核心问题——若将数字化比作建筑，底座如同地基，直接决定 AI 价值的上限。 围绕“地基”该怎么打，他直指企业常见的两条路径：自建数据中心，或全面上公有云。前者看似成本低，但现实往往事与愿违，“如果一个CIO真能把数字化底座建得非常好，那他其实已经可以去开一家公有云了。”在他看来，多数企业的自建底座仍停留在上世纪90年代的虚拟化技术，存在技术老旧、产品杂乱、稳定性和安全性难以保障的问题。 而公有云看似先进，却又带来了另一组难题：多云几乎是大型企业的必然选择，美的目前使用的云超过8朵，但彼此之间互不兼容，且迁移难、联动难，最终形成云孤岛、数据孤岛。在业内，一个数字化应用的跨云迁移通常需要至少半年以上。 正是这样的背景下， 刘向阳带领美的选

excerpt_i18n.en: On December 12-13, 2025, the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit officially commenced at the Sheraton Shenzhen Boao Tianrui Hotel in Shenzhen. As a benchmark event in the AI industry-academia-research-investment community, GAIR has consistently adhered to the core principle of "heritage + innovation" since its inception in 2016, dedicated to bridging cutting-edge technology with industrial practice. At a time when artificial intelligence is increasingly becoming a core variable in national competition, computing power is reshaping technological pathways and industrial structures at an unprecedented pace. The "AI Computing Power: The Next Decade" session held on the 13th focused on computing power—the foundational core of intelligent systems—engaging in systematic discussions from architectural evolution and ecosystem development to industrial implementation, aiming to clarify key variables and development directions for China's AI industry over the next decade. At the summit, Liu Xiangyang, Academician of the European Academy of Sciences, Chief Information Security Officer and Dean of the Software Engineering Institute at Midea Group, IEEE Fellow, IET Fellow, and ACM Distinguished Scientist, delivered a keynote speech titled "Neutral Cloud: A Unified Multi-Cloud Digital Foundation Empowering AI and Empowered by AI," sharing Midea's practical journey in enterprise digitalization and AI implementation. With deep expertise in digitalization and information security, Liu Xiangyang previously served as Chief Scientist at Ant Group and as a professor at a U.S. university, and now leads digital foundation and information security initiatives at Midea Group. He astutely pointed out that many enterprises currently face the core challenge of "weak digital foundations" in AI implementation—if digitalization is likened to a building, the foundation is akin to the ground.
